checkpoints.description: [1/2] Make the relief sweep travel to a devastated world and restock on the way

impact_assessment.benefits: Relief Runner banks on both flagged seeds; the remaining codex gap closes without raising the step guard again; deterministic and stdlib-only
impact_assessment.mitigation: 19 failing-first unit tests in tests/test_relief_travel.py, two 5,000-step benchmark campaigns on seeds 1 and 42, the unchanged 180-step gate, and a Phase 4 aikit check
impact_assessment.risks: contract: three new bounded helper actions inside the existing sweep; dependency: /api/galaxy catalogue and published jump costs already used by the hunt; concurrency: none; state: one in-memory jump counter, no save-field change; step-clock shifts may churn encounter-bound entries
impact_assessment.why: ADR-453 left Relief Runner at 1/3 and 0/3 on seeds 1 and 42: a stocked hold drifted for a thousand steps because the sweep returned early when the current system held no devastated target, and an empty hold never restocked on the trek
